newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shell Pernis cat cracker down for three months.
newsitem.headline: Shell Pernis cat cracker down for three months.

text.p: A catalytic cracker at Shell's Pernis refinery in Rotterdam will be down for an unscheduled stoppage in August followed by a scheduled stoppage of two months, a Shell trader said on Friday.
"It's unplanned since yesterday," a Shell trader said.
Shell had planned a two month shutdown and revamp of the cat cracker this autumn, but the trader said it would now be brought forward to follow the unscheduled stoppage.
"In total, it's three months. Mogas production will be down by 100,000 tonnes a month (28,000 barrels per day)," he said.
A Shell spokesman confirmed Shell was having problems with its number two catalytic cracker.
"I can confirm we have problems with the cat cracker and we are evaluating the situation," he said.
Shell has two catalytic crackers at its Pernis site. One, which is due to shut following the opening of Shell's "Per+" complex, is working normally.
